title: neottia aestivalis
intro: Neottia aestivalis, commonly known as Yellow Fringed Orchid, is a type of terrestrial orchid native to eastern North America. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of Neottia aestivalis are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are known to exhibit analgesic, anti-hemorrhagic, and antispasmodic effects. The bioactive constituents of Neottia aestivalis contribute to its traditional use in folk medicine for treating various ailments, including fever, rheumatism, and wounds.
